test.create_query: CREATE TABLE merge_scalar_sales (ss_item_sk UInt32, ss_ticket_number UInt64, ss_quantity Nullable(Int32), ss_ext_discount_amt Nullable(Decimal(7, 2)), ss_net_paid Nullable(Decimal(7, 2))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (ss_item_sk, ss_ticket_number)
CREATE TABLE merge_scalar_reason (r_reason_sk UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY r_reason_sk
CREATE TABLE merge_scalar_data (k UInt64, a Int32, b Float64, c UInt32, INDEX c_minmax c TYPE minmax GRANULARITY 1) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE merge_scalar_wide (k UInt64, flag UInt8, payload String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO merge_scalar_sales SELECT number % 18000, number, if(number % 47 = 0, NULL, number % 100 + 1), toDecimal32((number * 7) % 10000 / 100, 2), toDecimal32((number * 13) % 20000 / 100, 2) FROM numbers(30000000)
INSERT INTO merge_scalar_reason SELECT number + 1 FROM numbers(35)
INSERT INTO merge_scalar_data SELECT number, number % 1000, number * 1.5, intDiv(number, 30000) FROM numbers(30000000)
INSERT INTO merge_scalar_wide SELECT number, number % 100, concat(hex(SHA256(toString(number))), hex(SHA256(toString(number + 1)))) FROM numbers(3000000)
